title: A scene can close its loop and still jerk

controls: Phase, harmonics, period, deformation mode, camera path/orbit; PNG/GIF export in square or wide format.
misconception: Matching the first and last rendered frames does not ensure a smooth 3D loop; a mathematically closed loop can still move implausibly.
connection: OuroWorld · 8 Oct 2026. Implemented analytic teaching lab; not OuroWorld inference, learned deformation or an evaluation.

title: What actually needs updating in a 3D scene?
idea: Color synthetic splats by whether their attributes change. Animate a cached lane and a per-frame update lane beside the composed image.
controls: Update fraction, frame-group length, error threshold, position versus color changes; proposed PNG/GIF export.
misconception: A stationary surface can change appearance. Reusing attributes does not remove the splat from rendering.
connection: ResStreamGS · 15 Oct 2026. Analytic teaching proposal; counts are hypothetical attributes, not measured codec bytes or wireless bandwidth.
recommendation: Best new research pairing: a visible reason to send less data, without confusing stability with background.

title: The sound moves the right way but misses the target

misconception: A monotonic slider response is not calibrated control. A model can rank targets correctly while missing their values, and measured effective damping is not necessarily material loss.
